instances.overview: This model is a fine-tuned variant of Google's pre-trained MobileNet-V2 architecture, optimized for lightweight, low-latency image classification tasks. The base model's feature extraction layers—pretrained on the extensive ImageNet dataset—were frozen to retain fundamental spatial features (edges, textures, and shapes). Custom dense and dropout regularization layers were then appended and trained on highly specific domain data to adapt the model for high-accuracy localized classifications.
instances.usage: This model can be use to identify diseases on a tomato leaf with just one picture of a leaf. You can also use this as a reference for training your own AI model for any other topic. To use this model you must download the whole thing here and put it all in a newly created folder, you can name it anything, and then you must create sevral other folders to put the files in it, the actual way is discribed in the discription, you could follow it and once you are done, you simply have to run a simple flask pipeline " python app.py" in the terminal of the main root folder in which all the sub contents are present and make sure your PC have python and flask integration installed in it earlier.
